title: THE DEATH OF A SAINT

105 THE DEATH OF A SAINT

The Saint lies in a bed,on which is a green coverlet, and is receiving Extreme Unction from a Monkin white Augustin robes, with a black cape,while a group of nine fellow Monks stand behind;in front on a small table are spread the vessels of the Sacrament;the Donor,in red dress,kneels in prayer by the bedside on the right; on the wall, above the Saint,is seen The Trinity,and on a ledge over the door of the apartment are three pewter dishes and other objects. The upper part of the panel is divided into two sections on the right,the Saint dressed as an Abbot, is seated in his study at a desk,and beholds a vision of a Cardinal;while in the other section,the Saint and three other Monks are walking in the grounds of themonastery

## 108 SCENES FROM THE LIFE OF SAINT BARBARA

On the extreme right the tower is seen in which the Saint is imprisoned;in the foreground is a canopied porch,from which the Saint is being brought forth by an Angel,and again is seen being baptized by Saint John, while the Trinity appears in the clouds above her head; in the centre,at a little distance, Christ is seen handing the Saint a martyr's palm;in the foreground is seen her father,Diocurus,in Oriental costume,brandishing his sword and threatening the Saint,who is concealing herself in a rock which opens for her protection;on the extreme left is seen Saint Barbara between two guards, brought before the Pro-Consul Marcian, who is seated under a turreted porch;a street and buildings in the background
